sql: select x.scenario_key, (select string_agg('[' || (e->>'turn') || '] ' || (e->>'who') || coalesce('/' || (e->>'kind'), '') || ': ' || left(replace(e->>'text', E'\n', ' '), case when e->>'who' = 'ferramenta' then 160 else 420 end), ' ## ' ) from jsonb_array_elements(x.transcript) e where coalesce(e->>'kind','') not in ('image')) as t from public.ai_sim_results x where x.run_id = '363d6ffb-38bb-4453-89ee-04a4f31a2c92' and x.scenario_key in ('sem_preferencia_datas','desconto','monossilabico')
